existing_loader.reason: the V2 row carries a 14-field scientific_identity and a graph_payload; it does not carry the V1 grouping metadata fields or the V1 protocol/budget hashes the V1 loader requires

required_additive_loader.name: RECOVERABILITY_V2_TRAINING_DATA_LOADER
qualification_requirements: byte-level replay: loading the sealed TRAIN and VALIDATION datasets must reproduce the committed row dataset roots
a numeric test proving one N=5 event and one N=16 event receive equal scientific weight
a fail-closed test for a partial event, a missing candidate and a wrong robot count
a determinism test: same seed, same group order
requirements: read rvt-recoverability-scientific-row/v2 rows and validate the rvt-recoverability-row-identity/v2 fourteen-field identity
group rows by decision event, keyed by (episode_id, realized_source_timestep); never emit a partial event
within an event, group by candidate topology and require both COMPACT and LINE to be present
within a candidate, group by robot_id and require exactly N rows
apply the frozen reduction: average equally over COMPACT/LINE and robots within a decision, then over decision events; a raw row mean is prohibited
emit no class weight, focal term or rare-class oversampling; class weighting stays NONE_UNWEIGHTED_BCE
batch as 16 decision-event groups per the hyperparameter budget, never as a flat row batch
enforce split boundaries: a loader instance opens exactly one split and refuses rows whose identity split differs
refuse any row whose schema_version is the V1 row schema; no V1/V2 mixing in one dataset or batch
deterministic shuffling seeded from a declared seed, shuffling decision-event groups rather than rows
exclude GENERATION_INVALID dispositions from the supervised mask and retain them as denominator evidence, never relabelled to 0
refuse N=24, Study-B and final-test identities fail-closed
